items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation. Adobe recommends applying the latest security updates as soon as possible.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento (PolyShell)
items.summary: This critical PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution via a crafted CacheWarmer cookie. The flaw is rated 9.8 (critical) and has been actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution, arbitrary file system write, application denial-of-service, and security feature bypass. Notable CVEs include CVE-2026-34686 (Stored XSS) and CVE-2026-34653 (Path Traversal).

items.title: PolyShell: unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical flaw in Magento's REST API that enables unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to any store by disguising code as an image. Attacks have been observed against a significant percentage of stores.

items.title: Critical Security Update: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This critical security bulletin addresses multiple vulnerabilities, including incorrect authorization (CVE-2026-21284), improper access control (CVE-2026-21285), and stored XSS (CVE-2026-21310), which could lead to escalated privileges and unauthorized code execution.
